blocks.source: 张巍GRE填空机经2000题 · Test 130 Section 2
blocks.noteTail: （原题及配套答案，仅供个人学习；暂不附讲解）

stem: The prime minister’s reputation for ____ was sullied when it was revealed that he had known of fraudulent activities taking place in the country’s banking system but failed to report them.

All countries have obvious incentives to learn from policy mistakes, but when a nation becomes (i)____, it may be (ii)____ to recognize and quickly correct errors. When it comes to learning the right lessons, nothing fails like prior success.
Because human emotions are behavioral complexes, they presumably took a very long time to develop. Therefore, a complete lack of any (i)____ human emotions in ancestral species is (ii)____.
colsZh: 不大可能的；难以置信的

stem: Recent research shows that although the overall parental involvement in education (i)____ during adolescence, the (ii)____ the nature and frequency of parents’ involvement and adolescent educational outcomes are no longer (iii)____: for some types of parental involvement, declines are appropriate, whereas increases may, in fact, have deleterious effects.

items.answerReviewReason: 校对认为配套答案不可靠
items.explanation: 配套答案为 空(i) B continues to matter、空(ii) A links between、空(iii) A satisfactory。冒号后说某些参与的减少是恰当的、增加反而可能有害，对应“整体参与在青春期开始减少，但参与与学业结果之间的关系不再简单”，更合理的是 空(i) A begins to wane、空(ii) A links between、空(iii) C straightforward。

stem: The government has been able to ____ the country’s most serious social, economic and political problems, but these problems remain and may be getting worse.

Despite the rather ____ conditions required for its preservation, the evidence for glaciation during the late Proterozoic is found on every continent, suggesting that ice sheets were present throughout the globe.
The movie’s ponderousness is ____ by the gripping performance turned in by the lead actor.
optsZh: 被证明不实的；与……不符的
